proof_body:
by
  intro p q P y t hP hy
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (P s) * y s)
      (Real.exp (P t) * p t * y t + Real.exp (P t) * (q t - p t * y t)) t :=
    hP.exp.mul hy
  exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
target_source: ∀ (p q P y : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt P (p t) t → HasDerivAt y (q t - p t * y t) t → HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (P s) * y s) (Real.exp (P t) * q t) t
